description: This file defines a scheduling system with FIFO order for executing jobs, including interfaces, implementations, and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: job
classes.description: Implementation of the Job interface, representing a scheduled task with a name and executable function.

classes.name: fifo
classes.description: FIFO scheduler implementation managing job queue with concurrency control.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the job.

methods.name: Do
methods.description: Executes the job's function with the provided context.

methods.name: NewJob
methods.description: Creates a new Job instance with a specified name and execution function.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Adds a job to the FIFO scheduler's queue for execution.

methods.name: Pending
methods.description: Returns the number of pending jobs.

methods.name: Scheduled
methods.description: Returns the number of jobs scheduled for execution.

methods.name: Finished
methods.description: Returns the number of jobs that have completed execution.

methods.name: WaitFinish
methods.description: Blocks until at least n jobs are finished and all pending jobs are completed.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the scheduler and cancels all pending jobs.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop executing jobs in FIFO order until cancellation.

methods.name: executeJob
methods.description: Executes a job and updates finished count, handles panics.
